# Saren.ai

> Saren Sakurai is a fractional CMO and AI operations consultant based in Orange County, California. He helps early-stage and Series A founders in SaaS, cybersecurity, and AI build AI-powered demand generation systems that produce predictable revenue. Notable work includes scaling demand at Cylance ($1.4B BlackBerry acquisition), Qwiet AI, and WethosAI — with documented results including 344% inbound lift, 70% CAC reduction, and 550% pipeline expansion.

## Services

- [AI Orchestration](https://saren.ai/ai-orchestration): Service offering for AI-driven marketing operations
- [Contact](https://saren.ai/contact): Engagement inquiries

## Case Studies

- [10-Touch Sales Play](https://saren.ai/portfolio/10-touch-sales-play): Multi-touch outbound system for senior AI executive buyers, built at WethosAI
- [120-Day Content Journey](https://saren.ai/portfolio/120-day-content-journey): Buyer journey demand engine architected at Cylance
- [Authority Engineering](https://saren.ai/portfolio/authority-engineering): Building category authority through structured content
- [Behavioral Lead Scoring](https://saren.ai/portfolio/behavioral-lead-scoring): Fit + engagement scoring system for B2B buyers
- [Dynamic Nurture](https://saren.ai/portfolio/dynamic-nurture): Behavior-driven email and content nurture sequences
- [Executive Dashboard](https://saren.ai/portfolio/executive-dashboard): Full-funnel ROI attribution dashboard built at CloudKitchens
- [Intent Data](https://saren.ai/portfolio/intent-data): Intent signal capture and activation
- [It's Good To Be Pitched](https://saren.ai/portfolio/its-good-to-be-pitched): TV spot storyboard case study
- [Sovereign Personas](https://saren.ai/portfolio/sovereign-personas): Buyer persona framework for sovereign cloud infrastructure
- [Thought Leadership Development](https://saren.ai/portfolio/thought-leadership-development): Executive thought leadership programs
